body: The stiff mop and the rinse bucket are tied in one bundle with torn warning tape. A paper tag with only a number on it hangs from the knot, and a stamp is smudged on the bucket.
title: Mop and rinse bucket, the first morning

body: A crew carried a tank used on the trial rows, still damp around the valve. I saw a worker rinse his hands in a ditch that flows toward the houses. The grass along that ditch was yellow.
title: The roadside sprayer
